Package edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.app

Class HallsApp

java.lang.Object
javafx.application.Application
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.app.HallsApp
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameView.Listener, TitleScreen.Actions
public class HallsApp extends javafx.application.Application implements TitleScreen.Actions, GameView.Listener
The JavaFX application: moves between the title screen and the game, and handles saving, loading and high scores.

Accepts --seed=<number or word> for the first new game. Without a seed (or with --seed=random) a random seed is chosen; it is shown in the side panel so the run can be reproduced.
